value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or uninsured. The lowest I can see is about 4.34% for insured, and about 4.44% for uninsured, from listings dated Oct 9 to 12, and the insured rate is available in Ontario. The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%, and rates are creeping up this month.
